home.eyebrow: Business connectivity, without the sales visit
home.title: Get your business connected in one sitting.
home.subtitle: Tell us about your shop, clinic or office in your own words. We recommend the right internet, phone and digital services, show an honest price and verify your documents online.
home.langNote: Available in English, Hindi and Telugu
home.howTitle: From hello to installed, without the paperwork chase
home.how1Body: Tell the advisor what you do and what is not working today. It asks only what it needs.
home.how2Body: Only products your business is eligible for, with every prerequisite shown upfront.
home.how3Body: Monthly, setup and first-month totals calculated instantly. Adjust quantities and see the change.
home.how4Body: Check your GST or Udyam details and upload documents online. Our team picks it up from there.
home.trust1Body: Every price comes from the product catalogue. Ranges are shown as ranges, never hidden.
home.trust2Body: If a product needs another service first, you see it before you choose.
home.trust3Body: Consent before documents, identifiers masked on screen, documents deleted after the retention period.
home.trust4Title: A person when you need one
home.trust4Body: Ask for help at any step. Our team sees your details, so you never repeat yourself.
home.finalBody: A few minutes, no sign-in needed to explore.
home.demoUser: I run a salon in Jaipur with 6 staff. UPI payments keep failing at the counter.
home.demoBot: Got it - a 6-person salon in Jaipur that needs dependable internet and billing. Do you have a GSTIN?
home.demoNote: Example conversation. Prices are catalogue ranges per month, excluding taxes.
home.askPlaceholder: e.g. I run a salon in Jaipur with 6 staff and UPI keeps failing
home.servicesBody: One partner for connectivity, calls, cloud, security and smart devices. One monthly bill.
home.kycTitle: Documents checked in seconds, not days
home.kycBody: Upload a photo of your GST certificate, ID and electricity bill. We read them on our own servers, check them against the registry and tell you exactly what to fix, right away.
home.kyc1: GSTIN found and active in the registry
home.kyc3: Bill is older than 90 days: upload a newer one
home.kycPoints2: Only real exceptions go to our team
home.kycPoints3: No GST? Verify with your ID, bill and DigiLocker
home.forBody: Pick your business to start with the right questions.

advisor.title: Business advisor
advisor.subtitle: Describe your business and what you need. I will ask a few questions and suggest options.
advisor.greeting: Hello! Tell me about your business and what you need help with. For example: "I run a small dental clinic and want reliable internet and remote monitoring."
advisor.basicModeHint: The AI service is unavailable, so the advisor is asking standard questions.
advisor.readyBody: Compare three configurations built from what you told me.
advisor.tierUnknown: City not in our data yet. Availability will be confirmed.

q.business_type: What kind of business do you run?
q.employee_count: How many people work in your business?
q.num_sites: How many locations or branches do you have?
q.city: Which city is your business in?
q.needs: What would you like to improve or set up? For example internet, billing, CCTV or phone lines.
q.has_gstin: Does your business have a GSTIN?
q.current_internet: What internet or connection do you use today?
q.monthly_budget_inr: Roughly what monthly budget do you have for these services?
q.done: Thank you, I have what I need. Your plans are ready below.

advisor.startSimilar: Based on what similar businesses usually choose.
advisor.startStated: Based on what you've told us so far.
advisor.startMore: Answer {n} more questions to fine-tune it.
advisor.planIntro: Here's a bundle based on your requirements so far:
advisor.planIntroReady: Here's the bundle I recommend for your business:
advisor.tailorBody: Share a few more details (team size, locations, what you need) and we'll fine-tune the products and price.

elig.tier_unknown: Availability in your city will be confirmed
elig.tier_fail: Only sold in tier {tiers} cities. Your city is tier {tier}.
elig.emp_fail: Needs at least {min} employees. You have {have}.
elig.sites_fail: Needs at least {min} locations. You have {have}.
elig.gstin_fail: Needs an active GSTIN, which you said you do not have
elig.gstin_pending: Needs an active GSTIN. We check it during verification.
elig.gstin_declared: Needs an active GSTIN. We check yours during verification.
elig.feasibility: Installation at your address is confirmed by our team
elig.prereq_ok: Works with a connection in your plan
elig.prereq_missing: Needs one of these in your plan: {names}

gstin.ok: GSTIN format and check digit are valid
gstin.bad_structure: This does not look like a GSTIN. It should have 15 characters.
gstin.bad_checksum: The last character does not match. Please check for a typo.
gstin.repaired: We read {read}; an OCR look-alike character was corrected to {fixed}. The check digit and the registry confirm it.
gstin.altered: The GSTIN printed on the certificate fails its check digit. Our team will check the certificate.
gstin.altered_suggest: The GSTIN on the certificate fails its check digit. The registry has {suggestion} for this business: a digit differs, which is not a reading error, so the certificate may be altered. Our team will check it.
gstin.typo: The GSTIN check digit does not match. Please check for a typo.
gstin.typo_suggest: The GSTIN check digit does not match. Did you mean {suggestion}?

udyam.bad: Udyam number should look like UDYAM-XX-00-0000000

gstin_registry.active: Found in the registry with status Active
gstin_registry.inactive: This GSTIN is {reg_status} in the registry. Our team must review it.
gstin_registry.not_found: This GSTIN is not in the registry. Our team will check it.

udyam_registry.not_found: We could not find this Udyam number in the registry. Our team will check it.

registration.self_declared: No GST or Udyam needed for your plan. The technician confirms your address at installation.

codes.gstin_required: These products need an active GSTIN: {products}. Remove them or add an active GSTIN.

doc.unclear: The photo is too blurry to read. Please retake it in good light.
doc.ocr_unavailable: We could not read this automatically. Our team will read it.
doc.fields_missing: We could not find: {fields}. Please upload a clearer photo of the complete document.
doc.straightened: Photo was tilted {deg}°. We straightened it and read it automatically.
doc.too_tilted: The photo is too tilted to read. Hold the phone straight above the document and retake it.
doc.number_blank: The Udyam number on this certificate is blank. Please upload the complete certificate.

number.mismatch: The number on the document differs from the one entered. Our team will check.
number.near: Almost identical to the number you entered. One or two characters may have been misread, so our team will confirm.
number.lookalike: Matches, after correcting a look-alike character (0/O, 1/I/J, 5/S, 8/B)

name.differs: The name differs slightly from our records. Our team will review it.
name.mismatch: "{name}" does not match the registry. Our team will check it.
name.word_changed: "{name}" differs from the registry: "{got}" instead of "{want}". The document may be outdated or edited, so our team will check it.

addr.differs: The address differs from the registry. Our team will check it.

city.differs: The city differs from the Udyam record. Our team will check it.
city.declared_ok: The bill is for {city}, as you told us
city.declared_differs: The bill address is not in {city}. Upload a bill for your business address.
city.chat_differs: You told us {chat}, but this registration is in {registry}. Plans and prices depend on the city.

bill_date.unreadable: We could not read the bill date
bill_date.future: The bill date is later than expected. Our team will review it.
bill_date.stale: This bill is {age} days old. Please upload one from the last {limit} days.

billed_to.match: The bill is in your business or owner's name
billed_to.differs: The bill is not in your business or owner's name. Upload a bill in the business name.

id_validity.expired: This ID expired on {date}. Upload a valid ID or use DigiLocker.
id_validity.unreadable: We could not read the validity date

signatory.owner: The ID holder is the registered owner
signatory.role_ok: Signs as {role}; confirmed by OTP e-sign
signatory.authority: {role} may not be allowed to sign for the business. Our team will confirm.

phone.pending: Confirm your mobile number with a one-time code

registry.same: Your GST and Udyam records are for the same business
registry.different: Your GST and Udyam records name different businesses. Our team will check.
registry.found_inactive: A {reg_status} GST registration ({gstin}) exists for this business. Our team will check.
registry.found_active: Your business has an active GST registration ({gstin}); your plan does not need it.

digilocker.not_owner: The DigiLocker name is not the registered owner. Our team will check.

docs.same: Your ID and bill are for the same business
docs.different: Your ID and bill name different businesses. Please check them.

verify.title: Verify your business
verify.subtitle: Takes about 2 minutes. We read your documents on our own server and check them against the GST and Udyam registries.
verify.consentText: I agree to share my business identifiers and documents for onboarding checks. Only what is needed is collected, identifiers are masked on screen, documents are processed on our server and never sent to any AI service, and they are deleted automatically after the retention period.
verify.docsSubtitle: Clear photos or scans, PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB each.
verify.gstinProducts: Your plan includes products that need GST: {products}
verify.verdict_pass_body: Your business is verified. You can continue.
verify.verdict_ask_body: Fix the items below and we'll check again instantly.
verify.verdict_hold: Our team will take a quick look
verify.verdict_hold_body: Some details need a person to confirm. You can submit now; we'll call you if anything is needed.
verify.phoneHint: So our technician and team can reach you. We send a 6-digit code.
verify.digiHint: No ID photo needed. Simulated in this prototype: in production the name comes from UIDAI.
verify.digiNote: We never ask for or store your full Aadhaar number.
verify.toReviewLocked: Fix the items above to continue
verify.readingHint: Reading your document on our server. This takes a few seconds.
verify.staff_pass_body: Approved at submission; no one needs to look at it.
verify.staff_ask_body: The customer sees exactly what to fix and can do it themselves.
verify.staff_hold_body: Possible risk: check the items below before approving.
verify.docsNeedGst: Your plan includes {products}, which need an active GSTIN, so the GST certificate is required. Upload a photo of each document; we read the numbers ourselves.
verify.docsNoGst: Your plan doesn't need GST. Just your ID (or DigiLocker) and a recent electricity bill. GST and Udyam certificates are optional. We read the numbers ourselves; nothing to type.
verify.sampleHint: Loads one of the case pack's sample businesses as if you photographed the documents. Only the code is shown here.

review.title: Review and submit
review.subtitle: Check everything once. Our team takes it from here.
review.submittedBody: Our team will review it and contact you. You can track progress in My orders.
review.helpHint: Some items need action. Fix them, or ask our team for help and submit anyway.
review.lockedBody: Your verification has items to fix.
review.verdictHold: Our team will confirm a few details after you submit.
